photo.caption: Demolition of the Berlin Wall in November 1989.
photo.description: People atop the Berlin Wall near the Brandenburg Gate on 9 November 1989. The text on the sign "Achtung! Sie verlassen jetzt West-Berlin" ("Notice! You are now leaving West Berlin") has been modified with an additional text "Wie denn?" ("How?"). Also in blue is the logo for ONCE, whose cycling team was started in 1989
